import arena,subprocess,re,sys,chess

 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b);break
 p=subprocess.run(['./think',b.fen(),sys.argv[2],'28'],capture_output=True,text=True)
 lines=p.stdout.strip().splitlines()
 print('\n'.join(lines[-3:]),flush=True)
 move=re.findall('bestmove (\w+)',p.stdout)[-1]
 assert chess.Move.from_uci(move) in b.legal_moves
 subprocess.run(['python3','arena.py','move',move])
